haikus.haiku:
Greasy sizzle swells
Oil glints, bacon drips, joy bright
Heat hugs the pan warm
Happy #NationalGreasyFoodDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Warm red sauce drips bright
Twist of noodles twirls like sun
Taste melts, soft joy sings
Happy #WorldPastaDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Canvas wakes to sun
Colors dance in morning light
Brushes sigh, joy spills
#HappyBirthdayPabloPicasso from @ClamBakeSanta

Vienna drums rise
silver notes float on air bright
joyful hearts dance loud
#HappyBirthdayJohannStraussII from @ClamBakeSanta
